nodes.name: HTTP: FastAPI /lookup (parallel inside)
nodes.notes: Calls the local FastAPI app served by flows/patient-lookup.py. That endpoint fans out to Svigg + SIS + Drive in parallel via emr_bridge.lookup_patient() and merges. Falls back to the Execute Command node if the FastAPI process is not running.

nodes.name: Fallback: CLI subprocess
